prompt: Create a warm, detailed anime illustration of a young woman relaxing in a cozy sunlit bedroom. The main subject is an orange-haired anime girl, lying on her stomach across a soft bed while reading an open botanical book titled The Language of Flowers. She has very long vivid orange hair tied into a high side ponytail, with loose bangs and many fine flowing strands spread over the bed, bright blue eyes, a gentle faint smile, and a calm dreamy expression. She wears an oversized off-white long-sleeve shirt, pale gray shorts, and white ankle socks, with both legs bent upward behind her and feet crossed. The room is a cottagecore bedroom filled with plants, books, flowers, and plush cats, rendered in polished high-resolution anime style with soft painterly lighting and delicate linework. The bed has white floral bedding, cream pillows, a green pillow, and a chunky sage-green knitted blanket in the foreground. Add a small wooden bedside tray with a clear glass of water, stacked gardening books, and a metal pot of tiny white wildflowers. In the background, include a white metal headboard, a large bright window with sheer white curtains on the left, and exactly five cat plush toys sitting along the windowsill/headboard area: orange, gray-and-white, white, black, and pale pink. On the right, show a wooden bookshelf with potted trailing greenery, framed botanical art, small books, a watering can, dried herbs hanging on the side, and exactly one gray-and-white cat plush on a shelf. Farther right, show an open closet with hanging pastel clothes and a wicker basket containing exactly three cat plush toys. Use warm morning sunlight streaming from the left, soft bokeh foreground flowers, cream beige walls, natural wood tones, botanical green accents, and an inviting peaceful atmosphere. Keep the composition vertical, portrait oriented, with the girl centered in the lower half and the cozy room details clearly visible behind her. Avoid modern electronics, harsh shadows, text clutter, extra limbs, distorted hands, or inconsistent hair parting.

promptZh: 创作一张温暖且细节丰富的动漫插画，描绘一位年轻女性在阳光明媚的舒适卧室中放松的场景。主体是 一位橘色头发的动漫女孩，她趴在柔软的床上，正在阅读一本名为 《花语》 的植物学书籍。她留着非常长的亮眼 橘色 头发，扎成高侧马尾，零散的刘海和许多细长的发丝散落在床上；她有着明亮的蓝色双眼，带着温柔浅淡的微笑，表情平静而梦幻。她穿着一件超大号的米白色长袖衬衫、浅灰色短裤和白色短袜，双腿向上弯曲并在身后交叉。房间是充满植物、书籍、花卉和毛绒猫咪的田园风卧室，采用精致的高分辨率动漫风格渲染，具有柔和的绘画感光影和细腻的线条。床上有白色花卉床品、奶油色枕头、一个绿色枕头，前景中还有一条厚实的鼠尾草绿针织毯。增加一个小木制床头托盘，上面放着一杯透明的水、堆叠的园艺书籍以及一个装有细小白花的小金属盆。背景中，包括一个白色金属床头板，左侧是一个带有透明白纱帘的大型明亮窗户，窗台和床头板区域正好坐着五只猫咪毛绒玩具：橘色、灰白色、白色、黑色和淡粉色。右侧展示一个木制书架，上面摆放着盆栽垂吊绿植、装裱的植物艺术画、小书、洒水壶、侧面挂着的干草药，以及书架上的一只灰白色猫咪毛绒玩具。更右侧展示一个开放式衣柜，挂着淡色系衣物，还有一个藤编篮子，里面装着正好三只猫咪毛绒玩具。使用从左侧射入的温暖晨光、前景柔和的虚化花朵、奶油米色墙壁、自然木色调、植物绿色点缀，营造出一种引人入胜的宁静氛围。保持构图为竖向肖像模式，女孩位于下半部分中心，背景中舒适的房间细节清晰可见。避免出现现代电子产品、强烈的阴影、杂乱的文字、多余的肢体、扭曲的手部或不连贯的发缝。
